title: 30-Minute Sessionization
summary: Write a SQLite query that assigns per-user session ids with a 30-minute inactivity gap and returns exact session start/end timestamps plus event counts.
fairness_notes: The grader uses Python's built-in sqlite3 module.
Use SQLite-compatible timestamp arithmetic and window functions.
anti_cheat_notes: Hidden tests include exact 30-minute boundary cases, duplicate timestamps, and cross-midnight sessions.
The output schema and row ordering must match exactly.
